verdict.rationale: Extend is an agentic document-processing platform with its own agents (Composer & Review Agent, document agents), so being able to plug in external MCP servers is a fair question. However, the evidence only documents Extend acting as an MCP server for outside clients ("Connect from your client", "Connect a chat or tool-calling client over MCP"). That is the opposite role and does not transfer to this MCP-client story. Nothing in the pack shows Extend's agents or workflows consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
